factsheet.heading: History
paragraphs: There are plenty of historic features in the church covering many centuries. The grounds of the church were allocated to monks by King Alfred in 918 and the first	church became active c 940 with monks from St Pieter's Abbey, Gent.

The church was rebuilt in late 15th century with some of that still remaining to this day.					
In the 18th century there was need for rebuild due to structural problems and growing numbers of people in Lewisham!  Further extensions followed with the galleries added and the chancel created and consecrated in 1881.						
Further re-ordering was undertaken	in 1995 to create the present arrangement of the chancel.

name: Parish Church of St Mary The Virgin Lewisham
